# Flores à Beira-Rio

> Atelier de preservação botânica artesanal em Coimbra, Portugal. Transformamos flores com valor emocional em quadros de arte botânica que duram décadas.
> Artisan botanical flower preservation studio in Coimbra, Portugal. We transform emotionally meaningful flowers into botanical art frames that last for decades.

Flores à Beira-Rio is a specialist flower preservation studio based in Ceira, Coimbra, Portugal. Founded by a Portuguese artisan, the studio uses exclusively handcrafted botanical pressing — no resin, no silica gel, no synthetic chemicals. The result is a professionally framed pressed flower artwork using museum-grade UltraVue® UV70 glass, ready to hang and designed to last a lifetime.

The studio serves clients across Portugal and all of Europe, receiving flowers by post or in-person drop-off at the atelier.

## Services

- [Flower Preservation (Preservação de Flores)](https://floresabeirario.pt/preservacao-de-flores): Artisan botanical pressing of fresh flowers into framed wall art. Prices start at €300. Includes museum-grade UV-protective anti-reflective glass. Payment in 3 instalments (30% / 40% / 30%).
- [Wedding Bouquet Preservation (Preservar Bouquet de Noiva)](https://floresabeirario.pt/preservar-bouquet-noiva): The most requested service. The bridal bouquet is preserved into a framed botanical art piece. Book in advance — peak wedding months sell out quickly.
- [Bouquet Recreation (Recriação de Bouquet)](https://floresabeirario.pt/recriacao): For flowers that are too old or damaged to press. The original bouquet is recreated with fresh flowers using photographs, then pressed and framed.
- [Framing Dried Flowers (Emoldurar Flores Já Secas)](https://floresabeirario.pt/emoldurar-flores-secas): For flowers already dried at home. Three options: frame as-is, recreate with fresh flowers, or a mixed combination.
- [Gift Voucher (Vale Presente)](https://floresabeirario.pt/vale-presente): A gift voucher for flower preservation, ideal for brides-to-be, anniversaries, or anyone who deserves a lasting memory.
- [How It Works (Como Funciona)](https://floresabeirario.pt/como-funciona): Step-by-step explanation of the full process from booking to delivery.
- [Options & Pricing (Opções e Preços)](https://floresabeirario.pt/opcoes-e-precos): Full pricing, frame sizes, and material options.
- [FAQ](https://floresabeirario.pt/perguntas-frequentes): Answers to common questions about process, flowers, delivery, and payment.

## Occasions Served

Wedding bouquets, christening flowers, birthday flowers, anniversary flowers, silver and golden wedding flowers, engagement/proposal flowers, bereavement and funeral tribute flowers, graduation flowers.

## Key Facts

- Location: Ceira, Coimbra, Portugal
- Ships to: All of Europe (Portugal, Spain, France, UK, Ireland, Italy, Belgium, Netherlands, Germany, Austria, Switzerland)
- Prices: from €300
- Turnaround: up to 6 months from receipt of flowers
- Method: 100% natural handcrafted botanical pressing. No resin. No silica gel. No synthetic chemicals.
- Glass: UltraVue® UV70 museum-grade, anti-reflective, UV-protective
- Tracking: Real-time order tracking at https://status.floresabeirario.pt
- Flower delivery window: Flowers must arrive within 1–5 days of the event (fresher is better)
- Languages: Portuguese (primary), English
